about_the_game:
Legends of Old is a retro-style co-op dungeon crawler inspired by classic RPGs. Battle deadly foes, find powerful items, and master unique classes in this modern take on an old-school experience. 

Go it alone or play with up to three friends as you face challenging enemies and push deeper into hostile territory. Every zone offers unique challenges and hidden secrets to discover.

Choose from a variety of unique classes, each with their own combat role and identity. Every class brings meaningful choices and powerful synergies to group play. Master your abilities through deliberate combat that rewards timing, positioning, and cooperation rather than twitch reflexes.

Designed for fans of the classics, Legends of Old is a deliberate return to when dungeon crawling meant danger, discovery, and camaraderie. Whether you're charting unknown tunnels or holding the line against impossible odds, every descent is a story waiting to be told.
